English: Log Shelter
A simple log structure, hastily built from local timber. Provides basic shelter for a handful of families on the frontier.
Wooden Hut
An insulated wooden hut, offering improved warmth and shelter. Attracts more settlers and allows for larger families.
Stone Stove House
A sturdier wooden house with a central stone stove, providing warmth and a communal hearth for extended families.
Smoke House
A communal smokehouse for preserving meat and fish, improving supplies for the growing settlement and supporting larger population.
Walled Yard
A timber palisade enclosing communal yards, providing security and space for livestock, aiding in community defense and supply.
Village Court
A central court for resolving disputes and holding gatherings, fostering unity and order among the clan.
Communal Hall
A large timber hall for feasts, councils, and celebrations, strengthening bonds and coordination among the people.
Elders Chamber
A fortified chamber for the clan elders, where leadership convenes to decide matters of war and peace, increasing unity and organization.
Village Assembly Hall
A grand assembly hall for clan gatherings, legal proceedings, and strategic discussions, empowering the community and horde organization.
Slavic Grand Izba
A monumental wooden palace, seat of the most powerful clan, symbol of unity and dominance. The heart of the Izba cluster.
